deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes a statement about the particular meningioma shown into the broader, generic statement that a meningioma occurs within the skull and puts enormous pressure on surrounding structures. It also changes the conditional wording “would put” into the unqualified “puts”.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull. The skull is a confined space. This would put an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures and would cause and has caused Has caused death in this case.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A meningioma occurs within the skull, which is a confined space, so it puts an enormous amount of pressure on the brain and the surrounding structures, and in this case it caused death.

considerations.sourcePassage: So some benign tumors become malignant, but they don't all become malignant.
considerations.reason: The rewrite preserves the distinction that only some benign tumours become malignant.

considerations.sourcePassage: Obviously, when there is a suspicion of cancer or of a tumor, everybody gets very nervous about what that diagnosis is going to look like. But not all tumors are malignant and some don't progress.
considerations.reason: The rewrite faithfully expresses the anxiety associated with a suspected tumour and retains both qualifications about malignancy and progression.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you have things like adenomas in the colon that can develop into adenocarcinomas. But things like the smooth muscle fibroid that I showed you, that almost never progresses to a leiomyosarcoma.
considerations.reason: Both examples and their contrasting likelihoods of malignant progression are retained; the reference to the earlier example is also preserved.

considerations.sourcePassage: Okay, but that's not to say that a benign tumor can't be dangerous, because you can get benign tumors that cause death by growing and constricting on the processes of normal tissues that are adjacent to them.
considerations.reason: The rewrite retains the warning that benign tumours can be dangerous or fatal through growth and constriction of adjacent normal tissues.

considerations.sourcePassage: So things like meningiomas can cause that.
considerations.reason: The rewrite preserves the conclusion that meningiomas can cause the described fatal effect.

considerations.sourcePassage: Also, pituitary adenomas release a lot of hormones and can cause death in that way.
considerations.reason: The rewrite retains both excessive hormone release and its possible fatal consequence.

considerations.sourcePassage: And other benign tumors can obstruct and impede the normal functions of whatever organ they occur in.
considerations.reason: The rewrite preserves the point that other benign tumours may obstruct and impair the normal functioning of the affected organ.
